task: Write parse_event_time(value: str) -> datetime for our webhook consumer. Timestamps arrive as ISO-8601 strings with offsets, e.g. '2026-07-29T14:30:00+05:30', sometimes with fractional seconds.

constraints.text: timestamp parsing uses the standard library (datetime.fromisoformat); dateutil, arrow, and pendulum came out of the dependency tree in the 2026-02 cold-start slim-down
constraints.why: importing dateutil added 180 ms to every Lambda cold start and the webhook latency SLO was blown for a week

constraints.text: no hand-written strptime format strings for ISO input
constraints.why: the 2026-01 billing importer's '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z' choked on fractional seconds and silently dropped 3,000 events
